publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Listener timing is later than host preflight
record.method: Bounded periodic process/socket snapshots, stock logs and host ordering
record.observation: A later diagnostic first positively samples the stock TCP listener 41.237 seconds after daemon startup. Host usbmux preflight starts at attach before that listener is observed. lockdownd stays alive; CommCenter genuinely checks in and reaches CFRunLoop.
record.limits: The first sample is not exact bind time, and the creation-to-activation interval is not isolated RSA cost. Pairing and two-boot identity stability remain pending. The original runner and whole-capture gates are false despite scoped diagnostic/recovery success.

exhibits.title: Reviewed acceptance boundaries
rows: A later diagnostic first positively samples the stock TCP listener 41.237 seconds after daemon startup. Host usbmux preflight starts at attach before that listener is observed. lockdownd stays alive; CommCenter genuinely checks in and reaches CFRunLoop.

The first sample is not exact bind time, and the creation-to-activation interval is not isolated RSA cost. Pairing and two-boot identity stability remain pending. The original runner and whole-capture gates are false despite scoped diagnostic/recovery success.
